opening.argument: The presentation centers on a Yahoo Finance interview about JPMorgan Chase’s stated $50 million commitment to help businesses affected by coronavirus. Its description identifies loans and other support for small businesses, while the interview describes partners providing flexible capital and technical advisors helping businesses adapt. The discussion also presents no- or low-interest loans and nonprofit support as forms of assistance. These are descriptions of support, not a promise of investment returns, and the material does not establish deceptive conditions. The request to subscribe to Yahoo Finance is ordinary channel engagement; it is not presented as a condition for receiving the assistance discussed.
